decision.next_authorized_branch: Replace the free-standing differential radiator with a ground-backed/cavity-backed element or an element-level neutralization topology that can reduce x/y coupling by several dB while independently tuning self impedance. Do not continue tuning the mirrored secondary branch or add another external correction stage.

evidence_scope: v1.42 is corrected-S4/mapped-EEP circuit evidence; v1.43 1x1 and 2x2 values are physical 10 GHz HFSS evidence. No 16x16 or EEP claim is made.
